meta.parties: Perera Et Al. v. De Fonseka Et Al

rules.statement: The expression 'surviving donee' should be interpreted as 'other donee' in a fidei commissum in Ceylon, where the circumstances justify interpreting the term to ensure the homogeneity of the property as a family endowment.
rules.supporting_quote: "These factors, in my opinion, justify the courts in Ceylon in interpreting the expression 'surviving' as 'other' in certain cases where perhaps the courts in England would hesitate to do so, and in doing so in the present case."
